top_signals.title: U.S. Diesel Prices Close In on April War Peak
top_signals.summary: A diesel-price shock may be approaching Western economies. top_signals.title: Malaysia Extends Rate Pause, Drops ‘Appropriate’ Language
top_signals.summary: Malaysia’s central bank kept its key interest rate unchanged as the economy continues to enjoy modest inflation and rapid growth, tweaking its monetary policy statement to remove a reference to its stance as being “appropriate”.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
top_signals.summary: Security experts have been sounding the alarm for years about the risks of using generic TV boxes that promise unlimited content streaming for a one-time fee, warning that they secretly rent the user's Internet connection out to strangers. But a groundbreaking new analysis finds these devices also routinely spoof themselves as mobile phones clicking ads on AI-generated websites as part of sprawling operation that seeks to defraud online merchants and advertising networks.
